description: Defines a function `shapeAgentGroupedSeries` that processes an array of record objects into a format suitable for grouped bar charts, organizing data by agent and another secondary dimension (like environment or cost category), with zero-filling for missing categories.

methods.name: shapeAgentGroupedSeries(records, groupBy = "environment", options)
methods.description: Transforms raw records into a structured dataset suitable for visualization, grouping by agent and an optional secondary dimension, and ensuring consistent categories across agents.
